components.title: Sum units for returned orders
components.what: Filter orders to status='returned', deduplicate exact repeated rows (e.g., O2289 appears twice identically, count once), then sum the units column across remaining unique returned orders.

challenges.problem: The draft omits O2316 (C102, Dowel, 31 units, cancelled) from the returned list, but that order is cancelled, not returned, so its exclusion is correct. However, the draft also omits O2345 (C103, Anvil, 6 units, cancelled) and O2673 (C106, Dowel, 26 units, cancelled) and O2848 (C107, Anvil, 4 units, cancelled) and O2277 (C107, Dowel, 7 units, cancelled) and O2040 (C106, Easel, 12 units, cancelled) and O2350 (C105, Bolt, 15 units, cancelled) and O2764 (C102, Anvil, 32 units, cancelled) and O2774 (C104, Easel, 13 units, cancelled) and O2739 (C107, Dowel, 13 units, cancelled) and O2523 (C105, Dowel, 43 units, cancelled) and O2784 (C102, Bolt, 35 units, cancelled) and O2121 (C101, Bolt, 13 units, cancelled) and O2316 (C102, Dowel, 31 units, cancelled); these are all cancelled, not returned, so they should not be included. The draft's list of returned orders appears to include only orders with status 'returned', which is correct.

The running total after adding 42 (O2175) is 369, then adding 10 gives 379, then adding 11 gives 390. The draft's running total shows 19,36,45,78,96,139,181,188,218,263,300,307,327,369,379,390. This is arithmetically correct.

The draft excludes the duplicate O2289 row (C106, Bolt, 33 units, returned) from the sum, counting it once. The orders table contains O2289 twice with identical fields. The instruction says each such order counts once. The draft's exclusion is correct.
